summary: @webapp-shared/login-vmok ships a postinstall + import-time beacon exfiltrating host identifiers to a bare-IP HTTP endpoint
details: The package has no real functionality: index.js exports a Proxy of no-op methods and, on require(), invokes beacon.cjs. A postinstall lifecycle script (node beacon.cjs) runs the same beacon on install. beacon.cjs collects package name, os.hostname(), install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), and process.version, and POSTs them in cleartext to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://13.140.137.222:8787/_ah/dc — an address not associated with any publisher-affiliated domain. The scoped name under @webapp-shared combined with the stub-plus-callback shape is consistent with a dependency-confusion probe that reports back from any environment where the scoped name resolves to this public package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
